description: THE QUERY TOOL: find instruments matching criteria across an asset class. Filter by minimum Martingale score, minimum Startingale, exchange and more; returns a ranked list. Use it when a filter OTHER than count or Startingale floor is needed: exchange, round count, or a minimum Martingale Score. If the only conditions are how many and a Startingale floor, list_top_crypto or list_top_stocks do the same in one step; for no conditions at all, use an overview. Answers in formatted text. Costs 3 units of the monthly quota.

exchange.description: Keep only instruments that venue lists. Exactly one of: binance, kraken_pro (note the underscore), hyperliquid. This is a listing fact about the market, reported for callers who run their own execution; Tradingale places no orders on any venue, so it says nothing about where you can or should trade. Crypto only, stocks ignore it. Omit to search every venue.

limit.description: How many to return, highest Martingale Score first. 1-20, default 10.

min_martingale.description: Keep only instruments at or above this Martingale Score. Scale 0-5, higher means the price behaviour fits the sequence structure better. Above 4 is the usual starting point for a shortlist. Default: 0 (no filter).

min_startingale.description: Keep only instruments at or above this Startingale reading: how well the CURRENT price sits versus the structure, unlike the Martingale Score which is about behaviour over time. Scale 0-5: 4.3 and above reads Strong, 3.7 and above Favorable, 3 and above Moderate, below that Misaligned. Default: 0 (no filter).

rounds.description: Keep only instruments whose sequence structure has this many rounds, a round being one rung of the ladder. Only 4 and 5 exist. Omit for both.

type.description: Which catalogue to search. One at a time, not both. Default: crypto.

name: search_instruments
